what: Every D8 portable object ocean-lab emits for the explorer at the committed seed (engine/vehicle/explorer-seed.json), exactly as the compiled emitter produces it. tests/engine-explorer-parts.test.js fails when the emitter drifts from this file; scripts/check-adr160-contract.mjs reads it as DATA to hold the shape, the frame convention and the force-model requirements against the other labs and CAD Studio.

provenance.basis: derived from the record's design vector by ocean-lab.explorer-parts 1.0.0, with the report's drawn shapes (explorer-drawings.json)

features.label: float hull: the report's float side elevation, revolved about its axis

provenance.basis: thin-wall estimate: the outline's surface and its two end faces x the assumed 3 mm wall x PETG at 1.27 g/cm3, 0 % infill; CAD Studio's report weighs the SOLID program at its density, an upper bound
the program's own geometry, a closed thin shell of revolution
about the centre of mass in the part's frame, from the program's own geometry, a closed thin shell of revolution; an estimate travels AS an estimate and a receiver must not re-derive it

axes.x: square to the axis (the hull is a body of revolution)
axes.y: square to the axis and to x
